newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-STEINHAUER TAKES TWO-SHOT LEAD IN LPGA CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-STEINHAUER TAKES TWO-SHOT LEAD IN LPGA CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Sherri Steinhauer battled the wind to shoot a par 71 and take a two-stroke lead after the second round of the LPGA Championship on Friday.
Steinhauer, followed her opening round 68 by remaining at three-under, good enough for a two-stroke lead over Leta Lindley, Chris Johnson and Barb Mucha. Steinhauer, has not won on Tour since 1994.
Lindley was the only golfer to break par, with a 69. Johnson and Mucha carded 73 to remain in the hunt.
Thursday's leader, and the defending champion, Laura Davies of Britain, posted a 75 to fall back to even par. Kim Saiki shot a 74 and is three strokes back as well.
The Du Pont Country Club is a par-71 layout over 6,386 yards.
